text_block_list.text: As predicted, the storm has come.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин, you look ready for the
Kikuka
Sho. A spot in the race is surely
yours if you want
it!
text_block_list.name: Interviewer A

text_block_list.text:
They say that if you decide to enter, you
could
upend the entire race. So, what
are your thoughts
on the matter?
text_block_list.name: Interviewer A

text_block_list.text:
I plan on taking part, of course. I've
spent my
summer preparing for it.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: She's entering after all, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Come on, there's something I need to
talk to her
about.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Before their decisive race, Мэдзиро Райан
wants to
check in with McQueen to
speak about their
plans.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's not here yet. I'm sure this is where
we were
supposed to meet...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Hello, Ryan. My apologies—am I tardy?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: No, I think that we were just early.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
So, McQueen, the media said you could
upend
the race. But that's not what
you're aiming to do,
is it?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, indeed not. My plans haven't
changed. It is
only the opinions of others
that have.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I've also heard people say that they
didn't expect
you to be a lead player in
the Classics.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: But... aren't they right about that?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I don't believe so. I've always expected
you to
contend well, haven't I?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: It's only you who doesn't realize it yet.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
They both understand each other very
well. And
that's exactly why they can't
settle their rivalry in
any simple manner.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
If Ryan hopes to beat McQueen, she'll
have to
surpass her in raw ability first.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So, Ryan, have you found anyone more
capable
than I am?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho is a 3,000-meter race.
It's my
specialty as a stayer.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
As you saw in our scrimmage before,
without a
strategy, I have the advantage
against you.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
What kind of weapon do you have that
can
defeat me?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: A weapon?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: I... I have a few...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
(Like my dashing, my explosive force,
my staying
power, my final sprint...
But...)
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
(Will that really work? I always lose
against
McQueen...)
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
(I'm so scared... I can't help but think
about how I
always lost when we were
kids.)
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
(Can I really stand a chance against her?
Even
with everything I've learned, I'm
afraid... Why...)
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Her muscles? Whatever do you mean,
Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I am aware of how splendid her physique
is. But I
also know that muscles alone are
not enough for
her to defeat me.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Sh-she's right, Trainer. My muscles aren't

enough...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: We change locations to the pool.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Um... I changed clothes, but I'm not sure
what this
is supposed to—
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
My goodness... what a change. You're
completely
different from this past
spring...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Your muscle tone is the same, but your
body
looks much more conditioned to
exert power in
racing. This is...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: The results of putting in the right effort.

text_block_list.text: The right effort? You mean...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I mean everything she's done so far. It's
true that
Мэдзиро Райан can't compete with
Мэдзиро МакКуин
when it comes to
perfection.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But that's also why she never gave up in
her
effort. She fights on, turning those
feelings of
inferiority into muscle.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A youth of sweat and tears—their rivalry
exposed
Ryan's weaknesses, but it also
gave birth to her
current physique.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I understand now. It's plain to see when
you look
at her.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Ryan, I can see that you are continuing
your
journey down an unchanging path,
and you're
doing it with extraordinary
speed.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I-I am? I don't really understand it
myself.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Like always, you're unable to see
it...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
But that's precisely why you can move
forward
without hesitation. You've found
yourself a good
partner.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
It is a pleasure to have you as an
opponent. So
believe in yourself.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Believe in the Ryan that your trainer and
I believe
in. As long as you run with all
of your strength,
then I'm certain it will
be a good race.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Run with all my strength... O-okay.
That's
something I can definitely
promise!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I can say with confidence that I've
worked hard
toward this day, all so I can
beat you!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан has gained the confidence
she needs
to compete. The great battle
between the two
Mejiro rivals is about to
begin.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
